central_claim: The published FET-fusion -> impaired-ATM -> compensatory-ATR-dependency hypothesis is assessed for internal consistency in public data and for transfer to EMC: part A finds the DepMap 'EMC' line is recorded as not carrying the fusion, part B grades the EMC tumour signature WEAK (GENERIC_ONLY) on two readable series, part C finds the CRISPR knockout instrument blind, part D finds sensitivity does not track the mechanism (1 of 4 tests), and section 8 reports a competing HRD-selected sarcoma ATR programme.

p1s.summary: The minimum-detectable-effect range '0.045-0.186 SD units' (printed twice, in the body and again in section 6.1) is correct but is carried by NO artifact field and produced by NO code, and the recipe as printed is ambiguous between t- and normal critical values, where the normal reading gives a visibly different range.
p1s.evidence: Re-derived at the pin. Using SE = |delta|/|t| from research/modalities/emc-atr-vulnerability.json -> part_b_emc_tumour_signature.per_platform[*].contrast_EMC_vs_all_comparator_sarcoma_PROLIFERATION_ADJUSTED, and MDE = (t_.975(df) + t_.80(df)) * SE with the Welch df carried in each block, the twelve DDR concept x series values are: GSE4303/GPL3290 ATM 0.1352 (SE 0.0445, df 12.7), ATR-CHK1 0.1856 (SE 0.0587, df 8.6), replication stress 0.1442, stalled fork 0.1531, S-phase 0.1098, checkpoint 0.0939; GSE24369/GPL6244 ATM 0.0646, ATR-CHK1 0.1113, replication stress 0.0760, stalled fork 0.0449 (SE 0.0148, df 12.7), S-phase 0.1182, checkpoint 0.1080. min 0.0449, max 0.1856 -> '0.045-0.186' EXACTLY as printed, so the number is right. But the prose (lines 565-573) states only 'SE = |Delta|/|t| ... at 80 % power and two-sided alpha 0.05'; a reader taking the normal critical values (1.960 + 0.8416 = 2.8016), the natural default when no distribution is named, reproduces 0.041-0.164 instead. And the value has no home outside the prose: `grep` for 'power'/'MDE'/'detectable' over emc-atr-vulnerability.json returns only 'underpowered:' status strings, and `grep -n 't_.975|MDE|minimum_detectable|.ppf(' research/modalities/emc_atr_vulnerability.py` at the pin returns nothing, so `--check` cannot re-derive it and section 7's blanket 'nothing is hand-typed here that the artifact does not carry ... --check re-derives all of it offline' does not hold for it. Section 8's banner shows the document's own convention: it names its one non-re-derivable exception explicitly; this one is unnamed.
p1s.fix: Either (a) compute the MDE inside emc_atr_vulnerability.py, emit it per concept per series into part_b (e.g. `minimum_detectable_effect_at_80pc_power`), and quote the artifact's range; or (b) keep it in prose but state the critical-value convention in the sentence that gives the formula ('t critical values on the Welch df carried in each contrast block, t_.975 + t_.80') and add the same one-line exception note section 8's banner already models, so a reader knows it is a hand derivation from committed fields rather than an artifact figure.

p1s.summary: This document has no `artifact_figures` entry in research/manuscripts/pinned-figures.json, so not one of its roughly two hundred machine-derived numbers is bound by a gate to the artifact field that produces it — and the document's own appendix records four separate rounds of exactly the drift such a binding exists to catch.
p1s.evidence: At the pin, research/manuscripts/pinned-figures.json lists 'research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-atr-vulnerability-assessment.md' in `targets` (so the supersession-marker rules apply) but its 99 `artifact_figures` entries name it in no `must_appear_in`: the populated docs are fusion-junction-aso-research-article.md (25), fusion-junction-aso-journal-article.md (18), nr4a3-degrader-paper.md (14), emc-biomarker-selected-classes.md (10), and seven others. research/modalities/tests/test_emc_atr_vulnerability.py tests module behaviour only (planted-signal recovery, verdict logic, classifier buckets); no test reads the manuscript's printed values. The failure mode is not hypothetical for this paper: its own Appendix records (i) artifact commit ce630e2b4's superseded snapshot surviving in prose in three places — '20,324 (93.2 %)' against `per_platform["GSE24369_series_matrix.txt.gz"].probe_mapping_diagnostic.n_mapped` 20629 / `accession_resolution_rate` 0.982, with ATM's sign wrong and S-phase/checkpoint transposed; (ii) '27,195' against `n_probes_mapped_to_symbols` 27196; (iii) '10,332' against `dataset_search.biostudies.total_per_query["NR4A3 sarcoma"]` 10331; (iv) '25 EMC-titled SAMPLE records' against 11 rows with `is_emc_titled: true` out of a 25-long list. All four are prose-vs-artifact drift, all four were caught by a human/seat re-derivation rather than by a gate, and every current value now reads correctly against the pinned artifacts (verified this round).
p1s.fix: Add `artifact_figures` entries for the load-bearing figures of each part, keyed to the fields they come from — e.g. part B `per_platform["GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz"].n_probes_mapped_to_symbols` (27196) and `.probe_mapping_diagnostic.accession_resolution_rate` (0.582), the GSE24369 pair (20629 / 0.982), part C `knockout_instrument_with_matched_comparator.axis_mean_sarcoma_pool` (-1.34) and `delta_FET_minus_matched` (-0.0065), part D `mechanism_tests[*].mean_rho_across_ATR_inhibitors` (+0.2123, -0.1637, -0.0903, -0.1379) and `specificity["expr::proliferation_MYC"].mean_rho_across_ATR_inhibitors` (-0.1711), section 8 `emc_model_identity_check.emc_labelled_samples[0].NR4A3_family_fraction` (0.0634) — so a regeneration that moves any of them reddens the commit that failed to update the prose.
